notes.title: Black Ops Cold War launches on Steam for 50% off!
notes.content:
Enjoy Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War, now available on Steam 🔥

Black Ops Cold War, the direct sequel to Call of Duty®: Black Ops, will drop fans into the depths of the Cold War’s volatile geopolitical battle of the early 1980s.

Secure it for up to 50% off for a limited time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985810
